== Notes ==
* The Cracked Armor is applied after the damage.
* This skill has a [[:File:Spirit Rift animation.gif|distinguishable animation]] during the 3 seconds before it takes effect, which makes it easy for players to avoid the damage.
* This spell will not [[fail]] if your target dies mid-cast.

== Trivia ==
* The functionality of this skill has changed since its introduction; see its [[/Skill history|skill revision history]] for details.
